verdict.rationale: Checkout.com's docs list 'Flow' (low-code embeddable UI) and a Mobile SDK for building native checkout experiences, which point to embeddable components rather than a redirect-only flow, but the evidence pack gives only a single title-level mention of Flow with no detail on customization options, in-page embedding APIs, or component-level docs — most of the surfaced integration options (Hosted Payment Page, Payment Links) are explicitly redirect/hosted rather than embedded. Missing for 10: detailed Flow/Frames embedding docs, customization/theming API reference, and independent hands-on confirmation of in-page (non-redirect) embedding.
